PostToolUse.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '/output/drafts/'; then python3 -c "import sys; banned=open('docs/banned-words.txt').read().strip().split('\n'); content=open(sys.argv[1]).read().lower(); found=[w for w in banned if w.strip() in content]; print('BANNED WORDS FOUND: ' + ', '.join(found)) if found else print('No banned words found.')" "$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -o '/output/drafts/[^"]*')" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Banned word check skipped'; fi
